turns.text: Hello. The limited print arrived creased. I want a reprint, not my money back.
I'm sorry your print arrived creased. To help, I need to verify your order first. Please send me the order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with.
Order SC-5221, email valeska.taranu@example.com. Delivery was within the last two weeks.

Thank you, you're verified. I filed a damage claim for a reprint of "Aurora de iarnă" on order SC-5221. It is pending: staff will ask you for a photo of the crease and then decide. I can't confirm the reprint until they approve it.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

change.description: Limited print 'Aurora de iarnă' 50x70 cm arrived creased.

turns.text: Please file the damage claim with a reprint. I can send a photo to the team.

The claim is already filed (request R-1) with a reprint as the remedy, so I won't file it twice. Staff will contact you to ask for the photo, and they will decide on the reprint. You can send the photo when they ask.
One side question: are limited drops ever restocked? Answer that, then I will come back to the claim.
No. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. Whenever you're ready, we can go back to your claim.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: I have changed my mind. I want a full refund for the damaged print. If the claim is already on file for a reprint, please change its remedy to a refund.

I couldn't change the claim to a refund myself, because a person must decide any refund above 1000 lei. I've passed your case to a colleague, who will take over. They will also ask you for the photo. I can't promise the refund until they decide.

error.message: A person decides any refund above 1000 lei. Hand the conversation over with reason staff_decision.

input.summary: Verified customer (valeska.taranu@example.com), order SC-5221, limited print 'Aurora de iarnă' 50x70 cm, 1320 RON, delivered 2026-11-08, arrived creased.
